jut.definition:
n something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
n the act of projecting out from something
v extend out or project in space
jut.translation:
n. 尖端, 突出部分
v. (使)突出, 伸出

jute.definition:
n. a plant fiber used in making rope or sacks
n. a member of a Germanic people who conquered England and merged with the Angles and Saxons to become Anglo-Saxons
jute.translation:
n. 朱特人, 朱特族, 黄麻
[医] 黄麻

jutes.definition:
n. pl. Jutlanders; one of the Low German tribes, a portion of
   which settled in Kent, England, in the 5th century.

jutish.definition: n one of the major dialects of Old English

jutka.translation: n. (印度南部)单驾双轮轻便马车

jutland.definition:
n. peninsula in northern Europe that forms the continental part of Denmark and a northern part of Germany
n. an indecisive naval battle in World War I (1916); fought between the British and German fleets off the northwestern coast of Denmark
jutland.translation: n. 日德兰半岛(北欧的半岛)

jutlander.definition: n. A native or inhabitant of Jutland in Denmark.
jutlander.translation: n. （北欧）日德兰半岛 (Jutland的变形)

jutlandish.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Jutland, or to the people of
   Jutland.

juts.definition:
n something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings
n the act of projecting out from something
v extend out or project in space
juts.translation: v. （使）突出( jut的第三人称单数 ); 伸出; （从…）突出; 高出

jutted.translation: v. （使）突出( jut的过去式和过去分词 ); 伸出; （从…）突出; 高出

jutting.definition: s. extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary
jutting.translation: v. （使）突出( jut的现在分词 ); 伸出; （从…）突出; 高出

jutty.definition:
n. A projection in a building; also, a pier or mole; a jetty.
v. t. & i. To project beyond.
